Invalid safetensors extents dtype shape and payload are rejected
Real Hike Euler returns numeric result and preserves caller arrays
Euler rejects invalid dtype shape and nonfinite values
Euler enforces its tensor budget before result allocation
Stale worker replies cannot settle the active request
Actual Hike schedule exposes exact simple6 and HIGH LOW split with six times
Actual Hike noise inverse and flow primitives preserve caller bytes and shape
Pointwise primitives reject shape dtype nonfinite singular and overbudget input
Published tensor boundary validation returns metadata only and rejects mixed spaces provenance
Diffusion Hike explicitly normalizes raw means and restores published binary readback
Raw mean normalization rejects wrong meaning model shape and generated sample semantics
Real Hike ORT Hike partial projection computes literal without claiming model inference
Both actual weight tiles pass independent tolerance through external partial API
Legacy single-file load stays NOT_READY and unloaded model operations require a pair
Identity protocol and unsupported operations are rejected before work
New input revision terminates the older job and suppresses its result
Busy refusal and cancellation settle active request then allow reuse
Explicit MessagePort returns binary results with echoed identifiers
Cancelling a pending partial pipeline allows a fresh real partial result
